content: At the international level, ISO standards provide the framework. Beyond the ISO 9001 quality management system, there are thousands of specific ISO standards that define material properties, testing methods, and product specifications. For example, when Alpha purchases steel, it should be specified according to a standard like ISO 630 ("Structural steels"). When a casting is tested for hardness, the test should be conducted according to the procedures outlined in ISO 6506 (Brinell), ISO 6507 (Vickers), or ISO 6508 (Rockwell). Adherence to these international standards ensures a common language of quality and allows for objective comparison of products from different suppliers, including global competitors like Euro-Industrial Solutions SE , who would base their entire quality system on these norms. Locally, the South African Bureau of Standards (SABS) plays a critical role. The SABS develops national standards (SANS) and provides certification services.
